ranking_policy: official urban taxi stand, explicit vehicle entrance, service/public-road junction, ground-road reference; preserve evidence-kind diversity
unknown_barrier_policy: exclude gate node and interior service-road nodes without confirmed public access
area_price_range_scope: only evaluated candidates, never the whole area or final fare
notes: Absence of a restriction tag is not proof of legal curbside stopping.
OSM roads supplement official locations and taxi stands; no hardcoded library candidate IDs.
Session history is local; no global live-map response cache.
Different evidence types are retained so nearby official stands do not remove every entrance alternative.

place_resolution.area_policy: query exact same-name station before geographic duplicates
place_resolution.name_completion: unique cluster, one missing Chinese character, query length >=4
place_resolution.semantic_fallback: same Qwen proposes aliases/visitor facilities; official API supplies coordinates
place_resolution.note: No place-name or coordinate lookup table; semantic queries must remain within the existing 400m landmark neighbourhood.
place_resolution.station_prefixes: 港铁/港鐵/MTR are transport labels, not part of the station identity

harbour_toll_policy.default: ordinary single hiring: actual toll plus return toll
harbour_toll_policy.same_side_final_destination: requires complete route with crossings; actual toll each crossing, no return surcharge
harbour_toll_policy.unsupported_or_unconfirmed: show distance estimate and explicitly exclude unconfirmed charges
